title: AI is a tool, not a friend or a grown-up
intro: AI can chat in a friendly way, but it's a computer program. It has no feelings, and it doesn't care about you the way people do.
Some apps make AI seem like a best friend. That can feel nice, but real friends and family are the ones who really know you.
AI is great for explaining, practising and ideas. For feelings, worries and big decisions, talk to a real person you trust.

game.prompt: Who is the right helper for each situation?

items.text: Explaining a step in a maths exercise
items.explain: AI can explain things patiently, again and again.

items.text: Feeling sad after a fight with a friend
items.explain: Feelings deserve a real person who cares, like a parent or a friend.
Brainstorming ideas is a great job for AI.
Tell a trusted adult right away. They can really help and protect you.
Translating a word is a quick job AI does well.

items.text: Someone you don't know asks you online to do something
items.explain: Requests from strangers go to a trusted adult, never to AI alone.

quiz.question: Does AI have feelings?
quiz.explain: AI can write words about feelings, but it doesn't feel anything.

quiz.question: Something is worrying you. Who is best to talk to?
options: A parent or another adult you trust
quiz.explain: People who know you and care about you can really help.

quiz.question: An app says its AI is your best friend. What's true?
options: It remembers you forever like a friend
It's a program, and real friends are people
quiz.explain: AI can be useful, but friendship is between people.

summary: AI is a useful tool for explaining and ideas. It has no feelings, so for worries, feelings and big decisions, talk to a real person you trust.
